sources.panelClass: 25 C laboratory LC cells under 1-5 V DC-offset stress
sources.retainedEquation: dn_a/dt = k_a N_s (n_s - n_a) - k_d n_a
sources.limits: Post-period direct kinetic measurement used only to resolve a rate left unidentified by the 1994/1997 period evidence; not a DMG measurement.

desorption.boundEquation: k_d <= -ln(0.695) / 600 s, because the adsorbed charge at ten minutes cannot exceed its value at stress removal
desorption.selection: midpoint of the later directly measured slow 0.023-0.028 min^-1 range; it satisfies the independent period upper bound

formation.classification: period-protocol reconstruction conditioned on the bounded desorption rate

opticalBridge.reason: The 1994 dependent variable is a visibility-voltage window rather than optical transmission, and no long-exposure DMG optical trace survives. The gain remains low-amplitude and separately testable rather than being presented as measured.

runtime.integration: exact first-order exponential per frame and per scanout partition
runtime.acceleratedDiagnostic: IonicTimeScale=60 applies the exact continuous-time exponent, so 30 seconds equals the normal 30-minute integration for identical drive history

claimBoundary: The direct DMG rate and optical gain are irrecoverable. The selected kinetics are a traceable reconstruction from period protocols plus a later direct kinetic measurement that satisfies the period bound; they are not factory specifications.
